llm_response.reason: The site mimics the official Jack Wolfskin brand with a .shop domain, displays a wide range of products at extremely low 'sale' prices, and lacks verifiable contact or company information. It is listed as untrustworthy by scam-checking services. There is no presence on the official Jack Wolfskin website partner or country list. All these signs align with common online shopping scam characteristics (unrealistic prices, fake brand, absence of company/contact details, warnings from third-party scam checkers).
